NP Presspad 1.4.0 — New foundations

This release moves NP Presspad onto a new major version of its application framework and a new generation of build tooling, and modernises how your passwords and database key are kept safe. The app looks and works exactly as before — this is groundwork, so future updates have a current base to build on.

**Companion plugin:** WordPress will offer a companion plugin update to 1.4.0. It contains no changes, but please accept it — until you do, the app will show a "Plugin version doesn't match" notice after each sync.

## Under the hood

- **Electron** 44 → 45 — the application framework (Chromium + Node.js runtime) moves to its latest major version.
- **Secure storage modernised.** Your site passwords and the key that encrypts your local database now go through Electron's newer asynchronous encryption, which replaces calls Electron 45 has deprecated. Your existing passwords and content are read as-is — nothing to re-enter, nothing migrated. If macOS ever rotates the underlying encryption key, the app now re-protects your stored passwords under the new key automatically.
- **Build tooling** — Vite 7 → 8, electron-vite 5 → 6 and the React plugin 5 → 6, moved together as one toolchain.
- **Settings storage (electron-store)** 11 → 12 — the library that keeps your app settings.
